content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER_WIN | Swastika Infra Limited (NSE: SWASTIKAIN) Swastika Infra wins ₹615.76 crore order from MSEDCL for Bhandup Zone distribution infrastructure works ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Client: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) - Order Value: ₹615.76 crore (incl. taxes) - Scope: Distribution infrastructure & system strengthening works in Bhandup Zone, Maharashtra - Execution Period: 24 months from LOA 📌 What happened: ↳ Swastika Infra received a Letter of Award for the above works, marking a significant contract win. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
